CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `recipes` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `userId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `bakeryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `category` TEXT NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `servings` INTEGER NOT NULL, `batchSize` INTEGER NOT NULL, `difficulty` TEXT NOT NULL, `rating` REAL NOT NULL, `reviewCount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `imageResName` TEXT NOT NULL, `labourCost` REAL NOT NULL, `overheadsCost` REAL NOT NULL, `packagingCost` REAL NOT NULL, `utilitiesCost` REAL NOT NULL, `profitMarginPercent` REAL NOT NULL, `isFavorite` INTEGER NOT NULL, `customSellingPrice` REAL NOT NULL, `laborHours` REAL NOT NULL, `laborRatePerHour` REAL NOT NULL, `instructions` TEXT NOT NULL, `photoUri` TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `special_deals` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `supplierId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `productName` TEXT NOT NULL, `currentPrice` REAL NOT NULL, `originalPrice` REAL NOT NULL, `discountPercent` INTEGER NOT NULL, `validUntil` TEXT NOT NULL, `description` TEXT NOT NULL, `terms` TEXT NOT NULL, `isUpcoming` INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `suppliers` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `userId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `name` TEXT NOT NULL, `categories` TEXT NOT NULL, `rating` REAL NOT NULL, `reviewCount` INTEGER NOT NULL, `openingHours` TEXT NOT NULL, `phone` TEXT NOT NULL, `email` TEXT NOT NULL, `website` TEXT NOT NULL, `about` TEXT NOT NULL, `isFavorite` INTEGER NOT NULL, `isMySupplier` INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `tasks` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `userId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `title` TEXT NOT NULL, `orderRef` TEXT NOT NULL, `dueTime` TEXT NOT NULL, `priority` TEXT NOT NULL, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `dayOfWeek` TEXT NOT NULL, `dueDate` TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_accounts` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `bakeryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `firstName` TEXT NOT NULL, `surname` TEXT NOT NULL, `email` TEXT NOT NULL, `passwordHash` TEXT NOT NULL, `bakeryName` TEXT NOT NULL, `phone` TEXT NOT NULL, `city` TEXT NOT NULL, `operatingModel` TEXT NOT NULL, `currency` TEXT NOT NULL, `specialty` TEXT NOT NULL, `isPremium` INTEGER NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_login_logs` (`id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `userId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `email` TEXT NOT NULL, `bakeryName` TEXT NOT NULL, `action` TEXT NOT NULL, `branch` TEXT NOT NULL, `timestamp` INTEGER NOT NULL, `notes` TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `user_profiles` (`id` INTEGER NOT NULL, `userId` INTEGER NOT NULL, `bakeryId` TEXT NOT NULL, `fullName` TEXT NOT NULL, `bakeryName` TEXT NOT NULL, `specialty` TEXT NOT NULL, `phone` TEXT NOT NULL, `city` TEXT NOT NULL, `operatingModel` TEXT NOT NULL, `currency` TEXT NOT NULL, `email` TEXT NOT NULL, `isPremium` INTEGER NOT NULL, `subscriptionPlan` TEXT NOT NULL, `logoUri` TEXT NOT NULL, `bankName` TEXT NOT NULL, `accountNumber` TEXT NOT NULL, `branchCode` TEXT NOT NULL, `vatNumber` TEXT NOT NULL, `address` TEXT NOT NULL, `defaultHourlyRate` REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`id`))
